newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound slightly weaker vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound slightly weaker vs dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound weakened a fraction against the dollar in the private-sector market on Thursday, bankers said.
Private-sector bankers said the dollar ranged from 3.3950 to 3.3975 pounds bid and from 3.3960 to 3.3995 pounds offered in the interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3962 bid and 3.3979 offered. The averages compare with 3.3946 pounds bid and 3.3972 offered on Wednesday.
But bankers differed on the long-term direction of the pound, which is supported by relatively high interest rates.
"It's going down because foreigners are rolling over their treasury bills, not bringing in new money," said one.
"The increase in the volume of treasury bills and the higher yields have brought the foreigners back, so the pound has been rising, or at least it's stopped falling," said another.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.390876 buy and 3.397866 sell.
